if doc.get("custom_list_of_consignments"):
    for row in doc.get("custom_list_of_consignments"):
        if not row.consignment_note:
            continue

        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Consignment Note",
            row.consignment_note,
            "invoiced",
            1,
            update_modified=False
        )

        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Consignment Note",
            row.consignment_note,
            "sales_invoice",
            doc.name,
            update_modified=False
        )

name: EwayBillEmail
script:
from frappe.utils import add_days, nowdate

tomorrow = add_days(nowdate(), 1)

consignments = frappe.get_all(
    "Consignment Note",
    filters={
        "eway_bill_expiry_date": tomorrow,
        "eway_bill_no": ["!=", ""],
        "docstatus": ["<", 2]
    },
    fields=["name"]
)

for c in consignments:
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Consignment Note", c.name)

    frappe.sendmail(
        recipients=["shivengupta11@gmail.com"],  # change this
        template="E-Way Bill Expiry Reminder",
        args={"doc": doc},
        reference_doctype="Consignment Note",
        reference_name=doc.name
    )

    doc.eway_reminder_sent = 1
    doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
